note: Ambiguity within one release (crates/DESIGN.md, "Concurrent releases"): `conc/t`'s releases "2003 - 2004" and "2004 - 2005" share 2004 and both deliver a column `Z`, holding age in the first (`zalder`) and occupation in the second (`zyrke`). Two releases reusing a column name for different variables do not contest it, so `zalder` is clear and orders from "2003 - 2004".
